title: 第15章 变异大鼠第16章 开箱
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
见几人都起来了，苏墨简单说明了今天要进行的任务，苏墨一人搜索图书馆和食堂，其余人就是教学楼和已经倒塌的宿舍楼。
目标就是找到一些可以用的东西。
“如果遇到处理不掉的事物第一时间发消息支援。”
苏墨沉声开口。
“好的苏兄。”
赵敢当回答的很积极，睡了一晚的他精神头很足，剩余二女也点头表示知道。
从外边看图书馆没有什么严重的破损，此时处于白天，就没有那么阴森恐怖，打开图书馆的大门进入，首先就是一楼的大厅，灰尘落了一地。
图书馆一共分为四层，中间部分是镂空的，日光能够透过顶上的玻璃直接照进大厅，苏墨一眼就能看清四周的情形。
这里挺不错的，苏墨觉得这里很适合放一些建筑，场地够大，光线适宜，通风也还行，前后两侧的大门敞开后，有风穿堂过。
慢慢的打开所有门查看，永恒降临后，其余东西都很少留下来，比如这座图书馆就连一本书也没有。
不像一些废土纪元的文明，在一些破房子里面还能搜到什么好东西，「永恒领域」的同化将一些东西都粉碎成渣了。
在这些房屋里，要担心会不会有什么东西藏在隐蔽的角落，在你放松时，给你来上一下，所以昨晚苏墨一行人都是在野外睡的。
等到苏墨搜寻到四楼时，听到厕所有动静传来。
“咕咕~，吱吱~”
伸头往里一看，一只身体有半人长的老鼠在啃咬着一块木板，猩红的眼瞳第一时间看到了苏墨，放下嘴里的木板向苏墨扑来。
修行了《基础五行诀》的苏墨反应能力也比正常人快上许多，顿时一记长矛就投了过去。
那只老鼠身上黑光一闪，竟在半空中借力闪开了长矛。
这肯定是一只一阶妖兽，苏墨心想，而且还觉醒了特殊天赋。
一个【鉴定】丢到这只老鼠身上。
[变异大鼠（一阶）]

生命值：100%
类别：变异生物
技能1，铁胃：在饥饿状态下，可以吞下基础材料存活，如树木、草、土等。
技能2，强制变形：强行扭转身体的其中一个部位。
技能3，嗜血：对血肉有着渴望，在嗜血状态下，理智降低。
简介：吞食了不明物的老鼠进行了变异，属于半个永恒生物，不会受到暗影的袭击。
苏墨在走道里面跑，大鼠也跟了出来，这只没脑子的老鼠，只想着吃掉眼前的血肉。
苏墨有些头疼，遇到一只变态的一阶生物，前世这边也没传出消息来有生物袭击。
大鼠冲向苏墨，张开嘴嘶吼着，一股腐臭味从大鼠的嘴里传出，应该是宣誓领地的信号。
苏墨一剑就斩向了大鼠的头，只斩出了一道血痕，散发着臭味的血液流出。
连续几剑不断劈在大鼠身上，压低着它的血量，每次劈砍，苏墨借力重新拉开距离，不断的受伤让这头畜生恼怒不已。
如果说丧尸的皮是坚硬的话，那么大鼠的皮就是韧性。
content_en:
Seeing that several people were up, Su Mo briefly explained the tasks to be carried out today. Su Mo alone searched the library and canteen, while the others searched the teaching building and the collapsed dormitory building.
The goal is to find something that works.
"If you encounter something that cannot be handled, send a message for support as soon as possible."
Su Mo spoke in a deep voice.
"Okay Brother Su."
Zhao Gandang answered very positively. He was very energetic after a night's sleep. The other two women also nodded to express their understanding.
From the outside, there is no serious damage to the library. It is daytime, so it is not so spooky. When you open the door of the library and enter, you will first see the lobby on the first floor, where dust has fallen all over the floor.
The library is divided into four floors. The middle part is hollow. Daylight can shine directly into the hall through the glass on the top. Su Mo can see the surrounding situation clearly at a glance.
It's quite nice here. Su Mo thinks it's a good place to put some buildings. The site is large enough, the light is suitable, and the ventilation is okay. When the doors on the front and back are opened, the wind can flow through.
Slowly opening all the doors and checking, after eternity arrives, very few other things remain. For example, there is not even a single book in this library.
Unlike some civilizations in the Wasteland Era, where you can still find good things in some broken houses, the assimilation of the "Eternal Realm" has smashed some things into dregs.
In these houses, you have to worry about whether there is something hiding in a hidden corner that can come to you when you relax, so Su Mo and his party slept in the wild last night.
When Su Mo searched to the fourth floor, he heard movement coming from the toilet.
"Gugu~, Zhizhi~"
He stretched his head and looked inside, and saw a rat with a body half the length of a human being chewing on a wooden board. His scarlet eyes saw Su Mo for the first time, and he put down the wooden board in his mouth and rushed towards Su Mo.
Su Mo, who had practiced "Basic Five Elements Technique", had much faster reflexes than normal people, and he immediately threw the spear.
The mouse's body flashed with black light, and it used its strength to dodge the spear in mid-air.
This must be a first-level monster, Su Mo thought, and it has also awakened a special talent.
An [Appraisal] was thrown on this mouse.
[Mutant Rat (First Order)]
Health: 100%
Category: Mutated Creatures
Skill 1, Iron Stomach: In a hungry state, you can survive by swallowing basic materials, such as trees, grass, soil, etc.
Skill 2, forced deformation: forcibly twisting one part of the body.
Skill 3, bloodthirsty: has a thirst for flesh and blood, and in the bloodthirsty state, the sanity is reduced.
Introduction: A mouse that has swallowed an unknown object has mutated. It is a half-eternal creature and will not be attacked by shadows.
Su Mo ran in the corridor, and the rat followed him out. This brainless rat only wanted to eat the flesh and blood in front of him.
Su Mo had a headache. He encountered a perverted first-order creature. There was no news of any attack from this place in his previous life.
The rat rushed towards Su Mo, opened its mouth and roared, and a rotten smell came from the rat's mouth, which should be a signal to claim territory.
Su Mo slashed the rat's head with his sword, leaving only a bloody mark and smelly blood flowing out.
The sword struck the rat several times in a row, lowering its health. With each strike, Su Mo used his strength to regain the distance. The constant injuries made the beast very angry.
If the skin of zombies is hard, then the skin of rats is tough.
